summary: Iteration 67 verified: caller default Leads list re-scoped to own book while global search, colleague filter (?user_id=), and All-leads toggle (?scope=all) preserve full access. Original-caller lock + Activity Log unchanged. 8/8 backend pytest cases pass; UI automation confirms toggle flip and lead-detail lock/audit trail.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/leads.py build_query correctly gates owner-scoping with `not search and scope != 'all' and not user_id`, so scope=all/search/colleague filter all bypass scoping as designed.
update_lead strips user_id (for callers) and original_user_id (all) server-side; PATCH with user_id/original_user_id no-ops and city persists.
Search bucket-span still works: bucket=pipeline&search=5770614172 returns raw-Ozonetel lead 600027 (pipeline:false, user_id:5).
seed_data_creation: Test PATCH set lead 600027 city='Jaipur-QA67'. No new leads created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified totals in preview: Himani default 5,144 (page 1 of 103), scope=all 119,813 (page 1 of 2,397), user_id=5 ~5,073, admin default ~119,813. Search 5770614172 on default pipeline tab finds lead 600027 (Anamika). LeadDetail shows '🔒 Originally assigned to Anamika Suman · locked', assignee-select disabled, Activity Log tab has Himani entries including City QA66 -> Jaipur-QA67.
rca_of_the_issue: Not a bug this iteration; regression re-scope of caller default list to avoid production connection-pool exhaustion cascade caused when default list queried the full 120k collection. Preview cannot reproduce the prod latency, but functional behavior (scoping + escape hatches + lock + audit) is verified.
